requirement_from_brief: Collect, organise and analyse NBA data
how_addressed: Official schedule for 2026-11-14 to 2026-11-17 (27 games with game id, tip time, venue and city), official team advanced statistics for all 30 teams, official final scores for 174 games, and the official injury report 11/13/26 07:45 PM ET (122 rows) - all captured and compared field by field with the values earlier sessions stored.
blocker_or_gap: Historical box scores and per-player game logs were never captured. Those two gaps block the most downstream work. See CQ-39 and NF-52.
verification_status: Captured 2026-11-14: 88/88 overlapping slate fields, 240/240 team-stat fields and 122/122 injury rows agree with the stored captures (scripts/capture_official_2026_11_14b.py)

requirement_from_brief: Originate own NBA lines
how_addressed: Lines originated for all 27 games of the live window by a walk-forward Massey margin model with ridge shrinkage plus a totals model shrunk toward the league mean. Both shrinkage parameters are chosen by validating on the most recent 20 percent of past games only. Code: scripts/strategy_lab.py, seeded and deterministic.
blocker_or_gap: The margin model is only modestly better than a constant baseline and the totals model is worse than one. Both facts are published rather than hidden. See NF-49.
verification_status: 131 out-of-sample forecasts; margin RMSE 15.900 vs 16.866 baseline, total RMSE 19.636 vs 19.464 baseline

requirement_from_brief: Research and develop strategies that generate useful signals
how_addressed: 15 rules across single bets, same-game parlays and cross-game parlays, each scored out of sample against nine gates. Six are exact mirror pairs so the losing direction cannot be hidden, and one is a null control.
blocker_or_gap: No rule shows a signal that survives its own p-value, FDR correction and the whole-board luck threshold. See NF-51.
verification_status: Largest edge any rule posted is 18.0 pp; the luck threshold for a board this size is 31.2 pp

requirement_from_brief: Run as a leaderboard competition with rewards for top strategies
how_addressed: A ranked board with a composite skill score, five reward tiers (T1 funded to T5 blocked) and a stake allocation per tier. Zero rules are currently in T1 or T2, so nothing is funded.
blocker_or_gap: The reward schedule itself needs an owner decision: prize contest, pool, or internal scoring. Dutch rules treat these differently. See CQ-36.
verification_status: Statutory position read; no reward rule approved. A unit currently means a paper unit

requirement_from_brief: Single bets, parlays and player prop combos
status: Singles and parlays priced; prop combos blocked
how_addressed: 12 single-bet rules, 1 same-game parlay rule and 1 cross-game parlay rule are scored. Same-game cards for all 27 games and cross-game cards for the four dates are published with fair prices. Four player-prop combos are listed and all four are blocked.
blocker_or_gap: Prop combos need per-player game logs to measure the joint distribution. Without them every cell is blank by policy. See NF-52 and CQ-39.
verification_status: 4 of 4 prop combos published as BLOCKED with the unblocking step; no value invented

requirement_from_brief: Each strategy must pass validation gates
status: Gates defined and applied; nothing passes
how_addressed: Nine gates: provenance, look-ahead, sample size, power, significance, FDR, stability, economics at an assumed price, and the whole-board luck threshold. Every rule is scored against all nine and the per-gate grid is published.
blocker_or_gap: All thresholds are proposals this project has not had approved. Two further gates are proposed but not built: pre-registration (G10) and price reality (G11). See CQ-38.
verification_status: Exact binomial tests used, not a normal approximation; Benjamini-Hochberg applied across all 15 rules

requirement_from_brief: Determine correlation values
how_addressed: Home points vs away points (r=0.128, n=174), spread residual vs total residual (r=0.014, n=131), and the same-game cover-and-over joint rate with its dependence ratio are measured from official results. Four player-level pairs and the cross-game pair cannot be measured and are left blank with the reason printed in the cell.
blocker_or_gap: Player-level correlations need per-player game logs. The cross-game independence figure is printed as an assumption, not a measurement. See CQ-39.
verification_status: Values, sample sizes and 95 percent intervals published on the Correlations page; blanks flagged

requirement_from_brief: Remove luck; build selectively skill-based strategies
how_addressed: Exact binomial tests against the market's fair-line rate; Benjamini-Hochberg across the board; a 5,000-iteration whole-board Monte Carlo producing a 31.2 pp luck threshold; date-block bootstrap for return intervals; split-half stability; mirror pairs so the losing side is visible; and a null control that must fail. It does: 47.3 percent on 131 games, p=0.60.
blocker_or_gap: The methods detect luck; they cannot manufacture skill from 174 games. Nothing on the board beats the threshold. See NF-51.
verification_status: Null control ST-NUL fails 8 of 9 gates, which is the check that the gates work

requirement_from_brief: Generate picks for every upcoming slate up to 3 days ahead, using originated lines
how_addressed: One priced row for every one of the 27 games in the 2026-11-14 to 2026-11-17 window (today plus the maximum three-day horizon) with an originated spread, originated total, fair moneylines, projected score and availability status. Generated by a pipeline that reruns without manual input.
blocker_or_gap: These are our own fair prices against our own line, so their expected value is zero by construction. No market price is connected, so nothing here is a bet and no value is claimed. See NF-55 and CS-36.
verification_status: 27 rows, one per game; 2026-11-13 games excluded because they were live at capture time (NF-54)

requirement_from_brief: Track how injuries affect rotation minutes and production
how_addressed: The newest official report is transcribed row by row with its timestamp; teams printed NOT YET SUBMITTED are published as unknown rather than as healthy; and the official season minutes, points, rebounds and assists vacated by players listed Out or Doubtful are summed per team-game, with a count of how many listed players fall outside the captured minutes table.
blocker_or_gap: Who absorbs the vacated minutes, and how much of the production they replace, is NOT quantified - that needs per-player game logs and on-off splits. The vacuum is published, the replacement is blank. See NF-52.
verification_status: 54 team-game rows; every minutes figure is labelled a floor

requirement_from_brief: Game flow analysis
status: Done for what the data supports
how_addressed: Rest days, back-to-back flags and rest differentials from the official schedule and the 174 captured results; projected pace from official team PACE; projected total against the league average; measured overtime rate; and a blowout probability from our margin prediction and residual spread. One row per game with automatic flags.
blocker_or_gap: No possession-level pace projection, no overtime model (a flat measured rate is applied) and no referee, travel or altitude effects - none can be sourced officially. All three are listed as missing rather than estimated.
verification_status: 27 rows; overtime rate 5.17 percent measured from 9 of 174 games; the missing factors are named on the page
